key: cancelled installer overwrites rolled back files

bf-ff09d06c286b307e995bf735.what: Cancelling relkit add can let an installer descendant overwrite restored project source and both lock formats.
bf-ff09d06c286b307e995bf735.root_cause: packages/create-relkit/src/generator-process.ts nativeRun uses interruptible wrappers for native drain promises but the finalizer only joins the immediate child.
bf-ff09d06c286b307e995bf735.fixed_by: Acquire the native stdout/stderr Promises once and retain an allSettled barrier. Uninterruptible process release joins child exit and both physical drains before transaction rollback, preserving primary and cleanup error handling.
